# Dottore Genius Invokation TCG PWA

#### **原作者信息**：

A cross-platform simulated game application of Genius Invokation TCG based on [dgisim](https://github.com/Jarvis-Yu/Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-Simulator).

- [website](https://jarvis-yu.github.io/Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-PWA/)

#### **我的备注**：

##### Windows部署步骤

###### 一、下载release包

Github：[https://github.com/LiuJiaCheng11/Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-PWA/archive/refs/heads/release.zip](https://github.com/LiuJiaCheng11/Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-PWA/archive/refs/heads/release.zip)

解压到某文件夹
![](file:///C:/Users/zjh/AppData/Local/Temp/enhtmlclip/Image.png)![](data:image/png;base64,)

或者直接Git Clone拉取

```
git clone https://github.com/LiuJiaCheng11/Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-PWA.git Dottore-Genius-Invokation-TCG-PWA
```

切换到Release分支

```
git checkout release
```

![](file:///C:/Users/zjh/AppData/Local/Temp/enhtmlclip/Image(1).png)![](data:image/png;base64,)

###### 二、安装Python

参考：[https://app.yinxiang.com/fx/03cf0618-621b-491a-a646-161d9deb525e](https://app.yinxiang.com/fx/03cf0618-621b-491a-a646-161d9deb525e)

###### 三、安装组件

确保这些插件之间没有，先卸载

```
pip uninstall flet dgisim qlet typing-extensions -y
```

再安装

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

###### 四、启动服务端

可以打开main.py修改端口号

![](file:///C:/Users/zjh/AppData/Local/Temp/enhtmlclip/Image(2).png)![](data:image/png;base64,)

启动

```
python .\main.py
```

![](file:///C:/Users/zjh/AppData/Local/Temp/enhtmlclip/Image(3).png)![](data:image/png;base64,)

成功后自动弹出浏览器

![](file:///C:/Users/zjh/AppData/Local/Temp/enhtmlclip/Image(4).png)![](data:image/png;base64,)
